question: I'm a CS 5th-year student (P-010) with a Tech Entrepreneurship minor. My Fall 2025 enrollment was just 15-348 and Table Tennis. Can I realistically complete all remaining requirements and graduate in Spring 2026?

domain_contributions.programs: P-010 has completed most CS milestones; TE minor courses largely completed (95-401, 15-390, 70-381, 70-311, 67-474). Remaining: 15-441, 15-316, and any missing TE minor courses
domain_contributions.schedules: 15-441 ✓ Spring 2026; 15-316 ✓ Spring 2026; TE minor courses 67-474 NOT in Spring 2026
domain_contributions.policies: P-010 in good standing — can take normal or approved overload load

key_facts: P-010 Fall 2025: only 15-348 (Embedded Systems) and Table Tennis — very light load
P-010 CS missing: 15-441 (Networking); other electives may also be pending
P-010 TE minor: 67-474 (Tech Startup Launchpad) taken Spring 2025 — TE minor may be complete
P-010 in good standing — can take 3-4 courses without issue
Graduation in Spring 2026 is feasible if remaining requirements fit within 3-4 Spring 2026 courses
wrong_if_single_domain: Knowing program requirements identifies remaining courses. Knowing only the schedule shows what Spring 2026 offers. Only combining reveals which remaining requirements can be satisfied in Spring 2026.
common_mistake: Overlooking the light Fall 2025 load and its implications for how many requirements still remain; or assuming all remaining courses are offered Spring 2026
reasoning_chain: Step 1 (programs): Remaining CS requirements — 15-441 and electives; TE minor likely complete
Step 3 (policies): Good standing → can take normal load
Conclusion: Graduation in Spring 2026 is likely feasible — P-010 needs to take 15-441 and any remaining electives; full audit of remaining CS requirements needed
